SELECT join_date, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur, min(valid_from) AS minvf, max(valid_from) AS maxvf
FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-20' AND DATE '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'dim' AS src, max(join_date) AS maxjoin, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS m, min(join_date) AS minjoin FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg', max(join_date), count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id), min(join_date) FROM stg_member_updates

WITH m AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT join_date) AS joins, min(join_date) AS j FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM m WHERE joins>1) AS multi_join, (SELECT count(*) FROM m WHERE j=DATE '2026-09-25') AS mem_925,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE s.join_date=DATE '2026-09-25') AS stg_925,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates s WHERE s.join_date=DATE '2026-09-25' AND s.member_key NOT IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member)) AS stg_925_notindim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date=DATE '2026-09-25' AND member_key IS NULL) AS nullkeys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date=DATE '2026-09-25' AND home_store_id=900) AS online,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_current)<>1)) AS bad_current
